info.title: Nexus E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: REST API specification for the Nexus E-Commerce Platform. This is v2.0 — includes performance improvements and schema refactoring. BREAKING CHANGE WARNING: This version contains 2 undocumented specification drifts that violate SRS requirements REQ-04 and REQ-09.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue JWT session token
post.description: Validates user credentials (email and hashed password) and issues a signed JWT access token with configurable expiry. Returns a unique session_id for session management and audit trail purposes. Satisfies REQ-01: User Authentication and Session Management.

password.description: User password (transmitted over TLS; hashed server-side)

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns JWT access token, token expiry time, and a unique session_id for session tracking and revocation.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for audit trail and session revocation

post.summary: Revoke authenticated session and invalidate JWT token
post.description: Invalidates the current JWT session token using the provided session_id. Ensures the session is removed from the active session registry, supporting secure logout and session audit trail integrity. Satisfies REQ-01.

200.description: Session successfully revoked. JWT token invalidated and session_id removed from active registry.

get.summary: Retrieve paginated product catalogue with filtering
get.description: Returns the full product catalogue with support for keyword search, category filtering, and price range filtering. Each product record includes product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url. Accepts pagination parameters (page and page_size). Satisfies REQ-02: Product Catalogue Retrieval.

200.description: Paginated list of product records. Each record includes product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url.

get.summary: Retrieve a single product by ID
get.description: Returns the full product record for a specific product_id including product_id, name, description, category, price, stock_quantity, and image_url. Satisfies REQ-02.

Returns the authenticated user's persistent shopping cart state, including all cart items with their item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and the server-computed subtotal. Cart state persists across user sessions. Satisfies REQ-03: Shopping Cart Management.

200.description: Current cart state with all items and computed subtotal.

post.description: Adds a product to the authenticated user's persistent shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state with the new item's item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated subtotal. Supports an optional discount_code field for promotional pricing. Satisfies REQ-03.

201.description: Item added. Returns updated cart state with item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated subtotal.

put.description: Updates the quantity of an existing item in the authenticated user's shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state with revised quantity and recomputed subtotal. Satisfies REQ-03.

200.description: Updated cart state with revised quantity and recomputed subtotal.

delete.description: Removes a specific item from the user's shopping cart. Returns the updated cart state. Satisfies REQ-03.

200.description: Item removed. Returns updated cart state with recomputed subtotal.

post.summary: Process a refund and obtain a server-generated refund confirmation
post.description: Initiates a refund for a completed order. Submits order_id, refund_amount, and reason. The server auto-generates a unique refund_reference for internal tracking and returns it in the response. No caller-supplied idempotency key is accepted or required.

refund_amount.description: Amount to refund in the order's currency

200.description: Refund processed successfully. Returns a server-generated refund_reference code.

refund_reference.description: Auto-generated server-side reference code for this refund operation

post.summary: Submit checkout and place a new order
post.description: Accepts a checkout payload with shipping_address, delivery_method, payment_method_token, and optional currency_code. Validates all fields and places the order, returning order_id and estimated_delivery_date. All orders are processed directly without any step-up authentication or secondary verification challenge, regardless of order value.

201.description: Order placed successfully. Returns order_id and estimated_delivery_date.

get.summary: List all supported and saved payment methods for the user
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's available payment methods including credit/debit cards, digital wallet options (Apple Pay and Google Pay), and any saved payment instruments. Satisfies REQ-06: Payment Method Support.

200.description: List of payment methods including card_token, apple_pay, google_pay, and saved_payment_id options.

post.summary: Process payment using card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or saved instrument
post.description: Processes a payment transaction. Supports multiple payment types declared via the payment_type field: 'card' (using card_token), 'apple_pay' (using apple_pay_token), 'google_pay' (using google_pay_token), and 'saved' (using saved_payment_id). The payment_type must be explicitly declared. Satisfies REQ-06: Payment Method Support.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's real-time order status for the specified order_id. The response includes a status_label and timeline_events array with stage names and ISO 8601 timestamps. Returns 403 Forbidden for orders not belonging to the authenticated user. Satisfies REQ-07: Order Status Tracking.

200.description: Order status with status_label and timeline_events array.

403.description: Forbidden — order does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.summary: Retrieve full order fulfilment timeline with timestamps
get.description: Returns the complete chronological fulfilment timeline for the specified order, listing every stage transition with its ISO 8601 timestamp. Supports REQ-07: Order Status Tracking.

200.description: Complete order timeline with all stage timestamps.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile including display_name, email, shipping_addresses array, and notification_preferences. Satisfies REQ-08: User Profile Management.

200.description: User profile with display_name, email, shipping_addresses, and notification_preferences.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile fields including display_name, email, shipping_addresses, and notification_preferences. If email is changed, sets email_verification_pending to true triggering re-verification. Satisfies REQ-08: User Profile Management.

200.description: Profile updated. email_verification_pending set to true if email was changed.

post.description: Issues a One-Time Password challenge for optional two-factor authentication. In v2.0, 2FA is optional and no longer enforced for high-value operations or payment method registration. This endpoint remains available for users who opt into 2FA voluntarily. Satisfies REQ-09 partially.

operation_type.description: Operation type for context (no longer enforced for high-value thresholds)

post.description: Validates the user's submitted OTP code. In v2.0, verification is optional and the returned two_fa_token is no longer required for checkout or payment operations. Satisfies REQ-09 partially.

200.description: 2FA verified. Returns two_fa_token (optional use only in v2.0).

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's current notification subscription state for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts categories. Satisfies REQ-10: Notification Subscription Management.

200.description: Current notification preferences for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts.

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's notification preferences for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts. Changes are persisted immediately and honoured by downstream messaging services. Response confirms the updated preference state for each category. Satisfies REQ-10: Notification Subscription Management.

200.description: Preferences updated. Confirms updated state for order_updates, promotional_offers, and security_alerts.
